# Thin-film iridescence

Soap-bubble and oil-slick colors from thin-film interference: a film whose thickness varies across the surface reflects different wavelengths, and the colors slide as the viewing angle changes. Works on any lit or unlit material.

<EffectDemo effect="thin-film" />

## Usage

```ts
import { patchMaterial } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { thinFilm } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/thin-film';

const effect = thinFilm({ preset: 'soapBubble' });
patchMaterial(mesh.material, effect);
const clock = new THREE.Clock();
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => {
  effect.tick(clock.getDelta());
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
});
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.thicknessMin = 250`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling; parameters marked _structural_ recompile the materials the effect is patched into.

## Parameters

| Parameter                  | Type                             | Default   | Range       | Description                                                                                         |
| -------------------------- | -------------------------------- | --------- | ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `thicknessMin`             | number                           | `250`     | 0 – 1500 nm | Thinnest film.                                                                                      |
| `thicknessMax`             | number                           | `650`     | 0 – 1500 nm | Thickest film.                                                                                      |
| `ior`                      | number                           | `1.33`    | 1 – 2.5     | Refractive index of the film (soap water 1.33, oil 1.47).                                           |
| `variation` _(structural)_ | 'noise' \| 'height' \| 'uniform' | `'noise'` |             | How thickness varies: swirling noise, bands up the object like a draining bubble, or one thickness. |
| `scale`                    | number                           | `1.5`     | 0.1 – 10    | Size of the thickness swirls or bands.                                                              |
| `intensity`                | number                           | `0.8`     | 0 – 1       | How much the film tints the surface.                                                                |
| `sheen`                    | number                           | `0.6`     | 0 – 3       | Film reflection added on top, strongest at grazing angles.                                          |
| `speed`                    | number                           | `0.15`    | 0 – 2       | How fast the film swirls (stops when motion is off).                                                |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset       | Settings                                                                               |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `soapBubble` | `thicknessMin: 150`, `thicknessMax: 900`, `intensity: 0.9`, `sheen: 1.2`               |
| `oilSlick`   | `ior: 1.47`, `thicknessMin: 300`, `thicknessMax: 800`, `scale: 3`, `intensity: 0.7`    |
| `beetle`     | `variation: 'uniform'`, `thicknessMin: 420`, `ior: 1.56`, `intensity: 1`, `sheen: 0.4` |
| `draining`   | `variation: 'height'`, `thicknessMin: 100`, `thicknessMax: 1100`, `scale: 2`           |

Apply one with `thinFilm({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Holographic & iridescent · tracked as story X11.2 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Kind:** material effect. `patchMaterial(material, effect)` splices it into MeshBasic, Lambert, Phong, Standard, Physical, Toon and Matcap materials, so lighting, fog and shadows keep working; `unpatchMaterial` removes it. See [material effects](/guide/materials).
- **Motion:** Freezes: when motion is off (reduced motion, high contrast or `effect.setMotion(false)`) the effect holds its current frame.
- **Size:** 7.8 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/thin-film`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Thin-film interference integrated over 16 wavelengths with the CIE 1931 color-matching functions.
